Registering function value A passes A as the timer argument. If the caller then assigns B to its own variable, line 182 still invokes A from the stored argument. Copying A to another variable before registration passes the same value. Passing B at registration changes the stored value. Mutation of state that A itself reads is a separate matter governed by A's body.
